items.name: pitant-time-series
items.title: PITANT TimeSeries
items.description: Multi-pen industrial time-series chart with legend, crosshair, wheel zoom, quality, gap, and provenance metadata.
items.docs: Import @pitant/charts/styles/tokens.css once in your app shell when you want PITANT chart tokens to override the built-in CSS variable fallbacks.

items.name: pitant-digital-channel
items.title: PITANT DigitalChannel
items.description: Stacked digital/state lanes for interlocks, permissives, modes, and alarm state with quality and provenance-aware tooltips.
items.docs: Use this block for discrete state lanes. Use pitant-time-series for continuous analog trends.

items.name: pitant-synchronized-dashboard
items.title: PITANT Synchronized Dashboard
items.description: Dashboard block with synchronized x-range and cursor state across analog and digital panels.
items.docs: Keep one ChartSyncGroup inside one tenant, site, and workflow scope. Do not synchronize panels across evidence or authorization boundaries.

items.name: pitant-datazoom
items.title: PITANT DataZoom
items.description: TimeSeries block with opt-in DataZoom minimap for high-density viewport navigation.
items.docs: Use DataZoom when the user needs overview-plus-detail navigation over a large source window. Leave it off for compact charts.

items.name: pitant-streaming-trend
items.title: PITANT Streaming Trend
items.description: Live-edge TimeSeries block that appends typed-array chunks without replacing the full source dataset.
items.docs: Use streaming append for live historian tails and lab telemetry. Do not use it for historical backfills that change schema or rewrite earlier timestamps.

items.name: pitant-multi-axis
items.title: PITANT Multi-Axis Panels
items.description: Synchronized TimeSeries panels for comparing signals with different units without forcing a false shared y-axis.
items.docs: Use this block when units need separated y-axis ranges. Do not use it when a single-canvas dual-axis overlay is required; that remains a future explicit chart mode.

items.name: pitant-export
items.title: PITANT Export
items.description: TimeSeries block with a PNG export command wired through the public chart export API.
items.docs: Use PNG export for screenshots, reports, and support bundles. Do not use this block as evidence-grade SVG export; true vector export is a separate Phase 5 task.

items.name: pitant-dashboard-overview
items.title: PITANT Dashboard Overview
items.description: Dense synchronized dashboard overview with production trend, equipment state lanes, and operating envelope panels.
items.docs: Use dashboard overview for one tenant/site/workflow summary. Do not use it to mix tenants, sites, evidence scopes, or authorization boundaries.
